\begin{pioverridebox}[PI Decision D19 --- Ontological Re-Architecture (CLOSED)]
\label{box:pi-decision-d19}
\textbf{Decision.} The continuous real scalar field $\Sx$, treated in UIDT
v3.9.x as the ontological primitive, is demoted to a historical macroscopic
effective-field description. The active v4.0 candidate primitive is a finite
relational-algebraic kernel, presented strictly as a research programme at
evidence class \catmark{D}. The decision is closed under the PI standing
instruction that scientifically determinate dispositions are approved.

\textbf{Scientific basis.} A scalar-gradient construction cannot generate
non-trivial curvature because $\mathrm d^2=0$; a single self-adjoint generator
also yields an abelian generated algebra on which its own inner derivation
vanishes. The manuscript supplies no non-circular bridge from the historical
scalar to the required non-commutative multiplicity structure. Retaining the
scalar as foundational would therefore overstate the available mathematics.

\textbf{Binding conditions.}
(i)~Part~I remains a formal research programme at \catmark{D}, not an
established ontology or theorem corpus.
(ii)~No Standard-Model-like block partition may occur in a core definition,
axiom, hypothesis, loss, or acceptance condition; candidate instances may
occur only downstream of target-independent predicates under GLBC.
(iii)~Historical quantitative results retain their incoming evidence classes
inside Part~III or the museum appendix.

\textbf{Status.} CLOSED on 23~July~2026. This is a governance determination,
not a new physics result and not an evidence-class upgrade.
\end{pioverridebox}

\begin{pioverridebox}[PI Decision D20 --- Part III Architectural Reassignment]
\label{box:pi-decision-d20}
\textbf{Authorized architectural change.} The quantitative content of the
former effective-scalar Part~III --- including $v$, $\lambda_S$, $\kappa$,
the EFT machinery, benchmark batteries, and cosmological calibration ledger
--- has no established derivation from the pregeometric kernel and therefore
does not function as active ontology. Under D20 it is reorganized as a
verification, benchmark, and parameter-ledger stratum. No quantitative result
is deleted or reclassified. The finite relational-algebraic kernel of Part~I
remains a falsifiable research programme at evidence class D; the passage of
Part~II remains open and supplies no continuum, metric, signature, Born-rule,
or Standard-Model gauge-group derivation.

\textbf{Historical scope boundary.} At the time of D20,
PI-DELTA-P6, PI-ET-P6, PI-MUSEUM, and P2 were explicitly excluded. They are
resolved separately below by Decisions D21--D24. D20 itself changes no
quantitative value and no evidence class.

\textbf{Application status.} The MSS-000 architecture is present in the
supplied watermarked baseline blob \texttt{7962e5e7}; this finalization patch
preserves D20 and does not authorize merge or freeze.
\end{pioverridebox}

\begin{pioverridebox}[PI Decision D21 --- $\Delta$ Evidence Status (CLOSED)]
\label{box:pi-decision-d21-delta}
\textbf{Decision.} The proposed upgrade of $\Delta=\DeltaGap$ from
\catmark{B} with uncertainty to an exact Class~A value is rejected.
Determination D18 remains controlling: $\Delta=1.710\pm0.015\,\mathrm{GeV}$
is a lattice-compatible reference with no UIDT-internal derivation of the
number and no operator matching to a physical particle observable. It is not
a particle mass and is not identified with the $0^{++}$ glueball.

\textbf{Status.} CLOSED: retain D18 and \catmark{B}. No external
counter-signature is required because no upgrade is made.
\end{pioverridebox}

\begin{pioverridebox}[PI Decision D22 --- $E_T$ Firewall and Class (CLOSED)]
\label{box:pi-decision-d22-et}
\textbf{Decision.} $E_T=\ETorsion$ remains a subatomic reference at
\catmark{E}; the proposed upgrade to Class~C is rejected because no
specified subatomic observable with uncertainty and no validated scale bridge
has been supplied. The MeV-to-neural, biological, cognitive, macroscopic, or
life/death transfer is barred from active v4.0 use unless a separately audited
physical channel, coupling, transfer function, observable, and empirical
protocol are produced.

\textbf{Status.} CLOSED: firewall confirmed; class retained at \catmark{E}.
\end{pioverridebox}

\begin{pioverridebox}[PI Decision D23 --- Historical Scalar Museum (CLOSED)]
\label{box:pi-decision-d23-museum}
\textbf{Decision.} Museum Route~B is final for v4.0. The historical scalar/EFT
material remains in a visibly marked, non-imported appendix. It is preserved
for provenance and regression audit, supplies no premise to Parts~I--III, and
may not be silently deleted or reactivated.

\textbf{Status.} CLOSED: reversible appendix retention approved.
\end{pioverridebox}

\begin{pioverridebox}[PI Decision D24 --- FSS/P2 Disposition (CLOSED BY QUARANTINE)]
\label{box:pi-decision-d24-p2}
\textbf{Decision.} Because the required raw data, immutable run artefacts,
seeds, configuration, and provenance are unavailable, FSS/P2 is placed in
archival quarantine. It contributes no active quantitative claim, no evidence
upgrade, and no manuscript premise. The disposition may be reopened only by a
new PI record after source-faithful raw-data audit. No simulation or result
reconstruction is authorized by this decision.

\textbf{Status.} CLOSED as a governance disposition; the underlying
scientific question remains unresolved.
\end{pioverridebox}

\begin{pioverridebox}[PI Decision D25 --- Programme and Manuscript Name (CLOSED)]
\label{box:pi-decision-d25-name}
\textbf{Decision.} The active v4.0 programme name is
\emph{Relational-Algebraic Pregeometry Programme}. The manuscript title is
\emph{Relational-Algebraic Pregeometry: Finite Kernels, Open Continuum
Emergence, and Formal Verification}. ``Unified Information-Density Theory
(UIDT)'' is retained as the historical name for versions~1--3.9, existing DOI
titles, repository provenance, and legacy notation.

\textbf{Application rule.} The scientific-content patch is audited and
applied before the isolated name-migration patch, so that branding changes do
not obscure substantive review.

\textbf{Status.} CLOSED under the PI's stated agreement with the naming
recommendation.
\end{pioverridebox}
